summary_1line: Yudhishthira asks about Indra’s past suffering, prompting Salya to recount how Indra feared the austere three‑headed son of Twashtri and sent nymphs to tempt him.

image_candidates.scene_text: A radiant three-headed ascetic sits in severe meditation, one face chanting the Vedas, one drinking wine, and one glaring toward the horizons like sun, moon, and fire.
Indra, uneasy on his celestial throne, commands a group of jeweled apsaras to go tempt the powerful three-headed son of Twashtri.
Celestial nymphs in glittering ornaments perform graceful, seductive gestures before the unmoved three-headed ascetic absorbed in harsh austerities.
